name: Sylvie
title: Keeper of the Wilds
description: A ranger who lives in the red hut on the forest's edge. She guards the woodlands and grasslands of Dragon Island — and the land, in turn, guards her. Sharp with her bow, handier still with a rope.
swordRankMaxedDialogue: Congratulations, you have finished the basic tutorial!
Before you go, let me explain to you how time works.
Time exists in Revoluts, with each comprising of Dawnrise, followed by Duskfall.
Each step you take is one unit of time. 50 steps/units change the half of Revolut — Dawnrise/Duskfall.
Resources on the map respawn (replenish to full) after certain amounts of time.
allRanksMaxedDialogue: Long ago, an ancient dragon, the size of a small village used to roam over these waters — The Southern Sea.
The dragon — Ymir — was benevolent, guarding these waters from foul creatures of the Abyss and intrusions from land alike.
In a war two centuries back, one of the belligerent factions tried to imprison Ymir, trying to tame him.
In a clash that saw the end of the war, the imprudent faction, and Ymir himself, he fell from the skies.
The Ocean Goddess wept, for she was rather fond of Ymir. Goddess Earth took it upon herself to ensure he got a proper burial.
Over 3 days, with her own hands, no magic, she raised mountains, planted forest, and covered Ymir with a landform,
one that is blessed of life. That is the story of Dragon Island.

dialogue: Well done! Don't worry too much about combat right now — it'll be explained later.
You fought well, but the forest is stronger.
(Hint: You can equip Weapons and Relics in your Inventory. To go there, click the 'treasure chest' icon in the menu.)

swordRanks.title: A Friend in the Forest
swordRanks.description: As you enter this brave new world, you run into someone who seems to need some assistance. A green-haired forest ranger?

success_dialogue: Welcome, {playerName} — this is Dawn's Journey.
Move around, you'll find random loot you can pick up.
There are some places you can't go to right now, but you will, later.
For now — can you go into the water and get me a Fish?

reminder_dialogue: Still waiting for the Fish. 'Walk' over the waters, you'll find one.
success_dialogue: Yum — can't wait to cook it! We can have it with some Bread. You don't have any? Here, take some. :3
I've also added some potato seeds to your backpack to help start your Farming journey.
Go to the Homestead area — the 'House' icon up top.
You'll find your Homestead there, and your Farming area.
Plant one potato seed per plot, water them, and wait.
Watch the magic. (Just code, you know.)

swordRanks.title: Heart of the Forest
swordRanks.description: Sylvie will teach you further about the game: Resources, and Gifting.

intro_dialogue: There are several locations that could be of interest to you — sometimes marked, and sometimes not.
For example, certain TREE icons indicate a Resource — in this case, one you can gather Wood from.
Can you gather 10 Wood first?
reminder_dialogue: The trees of the island are bountiful. You can gather some wood from them.
success_dialogue: Perfect — you now have enough Wood for a rainy day.

intro_dialogue: I need some Wood. Would you care to gift me some?
If you need more context, talk to me again.
reminder_dialogue: I need some Wood. Would you care to GIFT me some?
Characters (like me) will often have a list of Items you can Gift them.
When you Gift an Item, your rapport with them increases.
Once the rapport is adequate, the Character's Heart Rank levels up.
Meaning now you are closer to them <3
success_dialogue: Perfect! *blushes* Wood — I mean, the Wood is just what I needed.
Here's a gift for you too. My favourite whip.

swordRanks.title: Dragon Taming
swordRanks.description: Sylvie wants to see you grow stronger. She will teach you about Overworld monsters.

intro_dialogue: Hey you — back for more?
Defeat 5 of those monsters called Greenhorns.
They're sprawling around these parts. You know those lil baby dragons that keep fluttering around?
And again, if you need further help — Talk to me.
reminder_dialogue: Need help? Combat against wild enemies is easy.
If your World Resonance is higher than the Enemy creature, you win. Automatically — loot goes straight to your Inventory.
You also get some XP, which helps you Level Up!
success_dialogue: That was easy, wasn't it?
The Maker wanted the world to flow — no grinding the same enemy for hours just to progress.
Not the Maker as in God, by the way. God is a whole other thing you'll deal with soon enough.
Anyway — anti-grind, as they say. Now you know.

swordRanks.title: A Test of Mettle
swordRanks.description: Sylvie isn't playing anymore (or is she?), and wants you to prove yourself.

unavailable_dialogue: I'm not ready to face you yet.
intro_dialogue: Look at you — growing up strong.
Time for a taste of real combat.
Fight me. Show me what you've got.
reminder_dialogue: Combat against Characters: check out the Arena page — the button with the Gladiator Helmet up top.
The page has a detailed explanation of how combat works.
For now, just know this: Combat vs. Characters is the strategy side of the game.
I'd strongly suggest finishing the Dragon Island questline first — get the Story Items, get stronger.
If you're new to RPGs, we'll guide you through it in time.
success_dialogue: Was that too hard? I hope not. xD

intro_dialogue: There's a strange power on this island. Dark, yet… liberating. I don't know who it's coming from.
Maybe someone over on that island to the north.
(Pleasure Island to the north, Treasure Island along the same Y-axis to the west. Funny, right?)
Go find out what this aura is.
reminder_dialogue: Hint: You might have to fight this 'source of power'.
success_dialogue: Hela, you say? Hmm — is she hot?
I might have to go meet her myself sometime.
Thank you. We should rest up for the night.

swordRanks.title: A Simple Meal
swordRanks.description: You have grown close to the woodland ranger, and she wants to teach you Farming next.

intro_dialogue: Time you tried Farming. Grow 5 potatoes and show me.
Go to the Homestead area — the 'House' icon up top.
You'll find your Homestead there, and your Farming area.
Plant one potato seed per plot, water them, and wait.
reminder_dialogue: Head to the Homestead area — 'House' icon, up top.
Plant one potato seed per plot, water them, and wait.
Ignore Actions for now — those are technical upgrades that let you plant more crops.
You'll figure it out in due time, promise.
success_dialogue: Yayy — potaayytooozz!
You also just finished the basic tutorial!
As a gift for our time together, I left you something. Check your Inventory later.
Thank you for playing this game so far. I hope you have a good time here.
I know I did — with you. <3

swordRanks.title: Something Warm
swordRanks.description: Sylvie has been thinking about the strange woman on Pleasure Island. She wants to do something about it.

unavailable_dialogue: Come back in a bit. I'm thinking.
intro_dialogue: Hey. That woman — Hela — she's been on my mind.
She's clearly not from here. Not trying to take anything, not fighting anyone.
Just… there. On that island. Alone.
I don't know her. But I know what it looks like when someone's finding their footing in a new place.
I've been there.
I'm going to cook her something. Bring it to her, will you?
She needs something warm. Not a weapon, not a message. Just food.
Tell her it's from the forest.
success_dialogue: Here. Spaghetti. Don't ask why — it's what I had.
Just bring it to her before it gets cold.
And — be kind? I have a feeling she doesn't get that very often.

stages.objective: Deliver the spaghetti to Hela (Heart Rank 2)
intro_dialogue: Go. Bring her the food.
She's on the island to the west.
reminder_dialogue: She needs to actually trust you a little before she'll take food from a stranger.
Spend some time with her. Let her warm up to you.
Pun intended.
success_dialogue: She took it?
Good.
You know, I had this image of her as some terrifying force of nature. And she probably is.
But she's also just… someone a long way from home.
That's something I understand.
Thank you for going. I'm glad she's not alone over there.
Neither are we, I suppose.

dialogue: Imma build more stuff with this Wood!
Oh, how lovely! These'll make a wonderful stew.
Seeds! The forest thanks you — and so do I.
Fresh bread? You know the way to a ranger's heart.
